AUTHOR: Wu
TITLE: Dynamic identification and automatic counting of the number of passing fish species based on the improved DeepSORT algorithm
REGION: Vertical-slot fishway, middle reaches of the Y (Yarlung Zangbo) River, Tibet, China
SPECIES: Schizothorax o'connori, Schizothorax waltoni, Schizopygopsis younghusbandi, Oxygymnocypris stewartii
DATA: Own fishway monitoring video (Hikvision camera with LED light wall; 807 videos, 322 valid, March-April 2022); 13,216 labelled frames / 14,541 boxes for detection; ReID set of 83 fish / 6,274 images
V_EV: Sec. 4.2: 'The water body and suspended particles in the water make the light suffer from scattering and absorption effects'; no turbidity measurement or stratified results
D_EV: Sec. 3.2: '13,216 labeled images... are randomly divided into training sets and test sets according to the proportion of 8:2'
R_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'a fishway project in the middle reaches of Y river is taken as the research object' (single site/camera)
C_EV: Sec. 4.1: 'at frame 169, the algorithm matches the original ID1 target and recovers its tracking'; counting only on baseline crossing
E_EV: Table 5 / Sec. 3.4: 'compare the output results of the algorithm with the results of manual counting'; manual 726 up / 121 down vs algorithm 533 / 169, mACP 75.5%
ARCH: YOLOv5x detector (n/s/m/l/x compared) + improved DeepSORT (ReID deepened from 6 to 9 residual layers, 512-d features, 128x64 input) with virtual-baseline up/down counting
METR: Precision, recall, AP, mAP@0.5/0.8/0.5:0.95, FPS, ReID top-1 error, ACP/mACP counting accuracy vs manual counts
NOTE: Detection frames extracted every 5-10 frames from the same videos and split randomly 8:2 (frame-level leakage not discussed). Counting accuracy evaluated against two human reviewers' counts of the same fishway videos (upstream/downstream by species); it is unclear whether counting videos overlap with detection training videos. Confidence threshold for YOLOv5/DeepSORT not reported; C_ALL = P rests on explicit discussion of ID loss/re-counting (30-frame retention, washed-down fish counted as new targets). E4 = FNR via per-species recall. Pretraining not stated. LED light compensation described but illumination not quantified.
